json_patch.value: Fix: fix: Crew.test emits its start event before setup so a failed setup pairs. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/crew.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_crew.py. `Crew.test` emits `CrewTestStartedEvent` before `create_llm` (`eval_llm` now carries the requested spec, which the field's `str | Any | None` type already allows) instead of after it, so a setup failure's `CrewTestFailedEvent` has its opener on the scope stack. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8420)
